channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Analysis: Encouraging or infuriating? Verdict on the Vikings will be rendered by offseason actions
item.description: Believe it or not, the Vikings were tantalizingly close to a playoff spot in 2025. What conclusions can they draw from what went wrong this season?

item.title: She built a life in Minnesota. Now she carries her passport everywhere.
item.description: Saciido Shaie thought she had achieved the American Dream in Minnesota. Now the Somali American plans every move around the possibility of being stopped.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild rally for point but lose 5-4 in shootout to Kings
item.description: The Wild responded to one-goal deficits four times, with Matt Boldy getting the final equalizer late in regulation.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves shake off doldrums, beat Heat 125-115
item.description: Anthony Edwards scored 33 points for a Wolves team coming off a couple of recent poor performances.

item.title: In Minnesota hockey rinks, tariffs hit the boards
item.description: The dasher boards that line ice arenas in Minnesota contain aluminum components from Canada, adding tariff bills of thousands to rink renovations.

item.title: Small Business Administration bans thousands of Minnesota borrowers over suspected pandemic-era fraud
item.description: The agency’s leader said a review over the past week flagged $400 million in loans to Minnesotans with “suspected fraudulent activity.”

item.title: Olson: Top 10 political stories to watch for in 2026
item.description: A sneak peek at the issues sure to define the new year.

item.title: Minnesota investigates child care centers following fraud accusations
item.description: The Minnesota Department of Children, Youth and Families is investigating four sites highlighted in a viral video claiming fraud in the state’s child care program.

item.title: Meet ‘David,’ the man who spirited Nick Shirley around to Somali-run day cares
item.description: David Hoch had a long history of failed political ambitions. Then he paired up with a 23-year-old YouTuber to knock on doors at Minneapolis child care centers.

item.title: Hundreds march through Minneapolis to protest U.S. attack on Venezuela
item.description: Rep. Tom Emmer and others in Minnesota applauded Maduro’s removal, meanwhile.
